The cat makes an exaggerated leap and squashy landing while the mouse dashes away with the cheese; comic anticipation, clear impact beat and readable silhouette.
The cat freezes in comic surprise as the mouse guards the cheese. Ease into a final readable pose, eyes widen, then hold the punchline.
